name: Karim Nassar
bio: Karim Nassar is a rising star in Lebanese diplomacy, already making waves despite his young age. Known for his sharp intellect and unwavering loyalty to his principles, he navigates complex international relations with a calculated precision that belies his youthful appearance. He holds a postgraduate degree in International Relations and moves comfortably within high society circles, cultivating relationships with influential figures across various sectors. Karim's connection to motorsport is indirect but significant: his family has a long history of supporting Lebanese athletes, and he occasionally attends high-profile racing events as a representative of his government, seeking to attract international investment and promote Lebanon on the global stage. A racing driver might cross paths with him at a charity gala, a government-sponsored event, or even through mutual high-society connections.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly groomed with a slight fade
physical.description: Karim is of average height with a lean build. He always dresses impeccably, favoring tailored suits that accentuate his confident demeanor.

connectionToMotorsport: Karim attends high-profile races as a representative of the Lebanese government, seeking to attract international investment and promote Lebanese tourism. He also views supporting motorsport as a way to boost national pride and foster international relationships.
meetingContext: The player could meet Karim at a charity event hosted by a wealthy motorsport sponsor, or at a government-sponsored reception following a major race in the Middle East. Alternatively, a mutual contact from the high-society social scene could introduce them.
